title: HOW SEVEN MUMBAI WOMEN TURNED RS 80 INTO A PAPAD COOPERATIVE WORTH MILLIONS

title: HOW AMUL'S FARMER-POOLED CO-OP TURNED MILK INTO A RS 1 LAKH CRORE BRAND

title: Xi Jinping HUGS Trump In Rare Airport Moment As US President Arrives For APEC Summit | #shorts
text:
Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomed US President Donald Trump with a brief hug on the airport tarmac in Shenzhen, China, on November 18, ahead of the APEC Summit. Trump was seen stepping off Air Force One, waving to the crowd and embracing Xi before the two leaders exchanged a few words.

The greeting echoed Trump's welcome for Xi at Joint Base Andrews in September, when the two leaders last met. After the exchange, both presidents walked along the red carpet towards their separate motorcades.

text:
